# Voice

Never use em-dashes. Never write two endings.

**Counted rules:** the bold cap (at most one per piece), the metaphor word-family cap (~3 mentions, scaled by length), the rhetorical-device cap (no single sentence-shape more than twice), the long-sentence cap (<=10% of sentences at 25+ words), and the direct-address floor ("you/your" at 40+ per 1,000 words). No more than roughly 10% of a chapter's sentences should run 25 words or longer.
